description: This source file implements metrics consumers for RU (Radio Unit) metrics, including JSON logging, verbose logging, and stdout output for various metrics related to OFH (Open Fronthaul), SDR (Software Defined Radio), and dummy metrics. It handles different metric types, formats output, and references multiple external metric and helper files.

classes.name: ru_metrics_consumer_json
classes.description: Handles JSON logging of RU metrics.

classes.name: ru_metrics_consumer_log
classes.description: Handles verbose logging of RU metrics.

classes.name: ru_metrics_handler_stdout
classes.description: Handles stdout output of various RU metrics.

methods.name: handle_metric
methods.description: Processes a ru_metrics object and logs or outputs metrics accordingly.
